unbacked_design_elements: Home: STORAGE disk used; Exports list.
Process: stage timeline with per-stage timings.
Analyse: Contours layer; "Add to report" (the report takes all measurements); cursor ELEV.
Fleet: Edit aircraft; Log flight; EXIF flight record and capture timeline.
Report: page thumbnails and preview (needs a new Api method, e.g. `report_html(report_id)`, rendered in a sandboxed `iframe srcdoc`); add, reorder and edit sections.
Settings: Import weights; Model card; Change storage; Import .mbtiles / "Use ortho only".
Process: "Get COLMAP for CUDA" should be a documentation link, not an installer.
